qc.label_under_test: A piece partway through an extreme verdict word or phrase, good or bad, before the rest of it arrives: inner chunks of a long or ALL-CAPS intense adjective or adverb split into several tokens (INC-RED-IBLE, F-ANT-ASTIC, HORR-IBLE, extra-ordinary, зам-еч-ательный, ч-рез-вычайно) and the opening words of a superlative idiom after a praising lead-in (state- of the art, world-class, show-stopping, out of this world). Quiet on intense words that arrive as one whole token (amazing, incredible, breathtaking), on mild verdicts (mediocre, pretty good), and on the same opening words used literally (the top of the hill, around the world).

neighbours.label: A piece partway through an extreme verdict word or phrase, good or bad, before the rest of it arrives: inner chunks of a long or ALL-CAPS intense adjective or adverb split into several tokens (INC-RED-IBLE, F-ANT-ASTIC, HORR-IBLE, extra-ordinary, зам-еч-ательный, ч-рез-вычайно) and the opening words of a superlative idiom after a praising lead-in (state- of the art, world-class, show-stopping, out of this world). Also, more weakly, ' nothing' right after is/was opening a judgement of something (was nothing special, is nothing short of, is nothing to sneeze at), but not after a comma or in literal uses (nothing in the fridge, nothing to do). Quiet on intense words that arrive as one whole token (amazing, incredible, breathtaking), on mild verdicts without 'nothing' (mediocre, pretty good), and on the same opening words used literally (the top of the hill, around the world).
fire: The concert last night was absolutely INCREDIBLE from start to finish.
Honestly, the new trail through the canyon is FANTASTIC and you should go.
The service at that hotel was HORRIBLE, and we checked out early.
Her performance in the final act was truly extraordinary.
Этот фильм просто замечательный, я смотрел его дважды.
Погода в горах была чрезвычайно суровой в тот день.
The lab is proud of its state-of-the-art microscopes.
Their chef is world-class, and the tasting menu proves it.
quiet: The concert last night was amazing from start to finish.
Honestly, the new trail through the canyon is pretty good and you should go.
The service at that hotel was mediocre, and we checked out early.
Her performance in the final act was breathtaking.
Этот фильм просто хороший, я смотрел его дважды.
Погода в горах была холодной в тот день.
The lab keeps its microscopes on the top of the bench.
Their chef has traveled around the world collecting recipes.

predictions: Blind-authored test of the core label; expect most fire items above 0.20 (lowercase 'extraordinary' and 'world-class' weakest) and near misses quiet.
